bundle.shortDescription: Custom Discord Rich Presence for every desktop
bundle.longDescription: Decoy shows a custom Rich Presence on your Discord profile: any game or app name, your own text, images, buttons, a timer and the small icon next to your name in voice channels. It sits in the tray and uses next to nothing while idle.
